title: FPS+ADDONS Smooth Gameplay
description: This pack adds fps booters, smooth gameplay, and balanced addons for multiplayer and singleplayer!
body: A modpack that boots fps with performance mods, adds loads of quality of life mods like zoom mod, fullbright and others that work with multiplayer and singleplayer! Perfect for pvp, and .net servers! Feel free to add your own mods too it!
